newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-DLJ starts Wendy's as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-DLJ starts Wendy's as buy.

text.p: -- Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette initiated coverage of Wendy's International Inc as a buy and set a 12-month price target of $26 a share.
-- DLJ said it expects Wendy's same-store sales and margin trends will improve. The firm said it expects favorable pricing conditions for Wendy's should continue.
-- DLJ said Wendy's international expansion is accelerating, but remains small.
-- DLJ expects Wendy's to earn $1.20 a share in 1996 and $1.42 a share in 1997.
